newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: May 17 start for weekly Amsterdam Asiana freighter.
newsitem.headline: May 17 start for weekly Amsterdam Asiana freighter.

text.p: Asiana has gained scheduled rights into Schiphol and is set to start a weekly freighter operation on May 17.
The South Korean carrier, has operated a twice-a-month Boeing 747-400 freighter service into Amsterdam for two years but only on a charter basis until now.

However, Peter Kales, owner of Kales Airline Services, Asiana's Dutch general sales agent, told Reuters that the carrier has just been granted scheduled traffic rights into the Dutch airport and would now start a scheduled service.
He said he felt that the market was strong enough to take more capacity at the moment and did not think it would impact Korean Airlines Ltd.
Korean Airlines operates twice-weekly freight flights to Seoul from Amsterdam.
Asiana's weekly freighter flight begins each Friday evening from Seoul and travels via Anchorage which is a technical stop before flying on to Amsterdam.
Asiana will be handled by Avia Presto BV and Cargo Service Center at Schiphol, while transport will be carried out by Rutges.
